arguments.installCommand:
set -eu
. /opt/sui-code/java.env
command -v curl >/dev/null || { echo "Install curl through Ubuntu setup first" >&2; exit 78; }
[ -x "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" ] || exit 78
ROOT=/opt/sui-code/ide/java
mkdir -p "$ROOT"
STAGE=$(mktemp -d "$ROOT/.download-XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$STAGE"' EXIT
curl -fL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 2 https://download.eclipse.org/jdtls/milestones/1.63.0/jdt-language-server-1.63.0-202610191322.tar.gz -o "$STAGE/server.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' b1f2abe0b3cccb462cf64fb4a5587c7d09df60cf8be7748b152cbd89d018bdc4 "$STAGE/server.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
curl -fL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 2 https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/microsoft/java/com.microsoft.java.debug.plugin/0.53.1/com.microsoft.java.debug.plugin-0.53.1.jar -o "$STAGE/java-debug.jar"
printf '%s  %s\n' 4f4778d452a6a0665536f43ce4e32403a24be6593336b80dc85a322912859e24 "$STAGE/java-debug.jar" | sha256sum -c -
mkdir "$STAGE/unpacked"
tar -xzf "$STAGE/server.tar.gz" -C "$STAGE/unpacked"
cp "$STAGE/java-debug.jar" "$STAGE/unpacked/java-debug.jar"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/1.63.0" ]; then mv "$STAGE/unpacked" "$ROOT/1.63.0"; fi
ln -sfn "$ROOT/1.63.0" "$ROOT/current"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/maven"
if [ ! -x "$ROOT/maven/apache-maven-3.9.11/bin/mvn" ]; then
    curl -fL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 2 https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.9.11/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.11-bin.tar.gz -o "$STAGE/maven.tar.gz"
    printf '%s  %s\n' bcfe4fe305c962ace56ac7b5fc7a08b87d5abd8b7e89027ab251069faebee516b0ded8961445d6d91ec1985dfe30f8153268843c89aa392733d1a3ec956c9978 "$STAGE/maven.tar.gz" | sha512sum -c -
    tar -xzf "$STAGE/maven.tar.gz" -C "$ROOT/maven"
fi
echo 'Java IDE tools installed; existing JDK and java.env retained.'
arguments.name: Java debugger
arguments.uninstallCommand: echo 'Debug tools are retained with the environment; disable the Kit to stop using them.'; exit 1
